This is $2.50 per file per month if the file is reissued at least once in a month. MeridianLink keeps
this for administering the LDAP program.

We calculate this per borrower, so a joint file incurs this cost twice. We pass this along to CRA's
since the bureaus charge them for secondary use. Secondary use billing/reporting is triggered
whenever a customer reissues a file they wouldn't normally have access to using SREISSUE or
OREISSUE for the first time. Note that there is a 3 month lookback period for LDAP billing, even
though in theory the lookback should be for all time.

This is $3.50 per Fannie/Freddie reissue. We will also charge $3.50 once for a file if there are no
Fannie/Freddie reissues, but the lender reissued the file at least once. We pass this along to
CRA's since we charge them a fee for a Fannie/Freddie reissue in their system.
Includes LOS & Fannie Mae
